## Why Use a Stock Screener  
A stock screener is like a high‑powered filter for the massive ocean of equities. Instead of scrolling through endless tickers, you set criteria—price, volume, fundamentals, technical patterns—and the tool instantly shows only the stocks that match. For active traders, this saves hours each day and helps uncover opportunities that might be missed by manual research. In 2026, market data is richer and faster than ever, so a reliable screener can be the edge that turns a good trade into a great one.

## Key Features to Evaluate  

### Real-Time Data  
Markets move in seconds. Look for screeners that deliver live quotes, level‑2 depth, and instant news feeds. Delayed data can cause you to act on stale information, especially when trading volatile stocks or reacting to earnings releases.

### Custom Filters  
The best platforms let you combine dozens of parameters—market cap, P/E ratio, RSI, average volume, insider trading, and even sentiment scores from social media. Flexibility to save and reuse filter sets is a huge plus for traders who run the same scans daily.

### Charting & Alerts  
Integrated charting lets you visualize patterns without leaving the screener. Alerts via email, SMS, or push notifications ensure you never break a setup when a stock hits your trigger price or breaks a key support/resistance level.

### User Interface  
A clean, intuitive layout reduces the learning curve. Drag‑and‑drop filter builders, clear result tables, and easy export options (CSV, Excel) make the workflow smooth, whether you’re on a desktop browser or a mobile app.

## Top Stock Screeners in 2026  

### Tool A: Finviz Pro  
Finviz remains a favorite for its heat‑map visuals and powerful fundamental filters. The Pro version adds real‑time data, backtesting capabilities, and a screener that can combine technical indicators with proprietary sentiment scores. Its layout is compact yet informative, making quick scans effortless.

### Tool B: [TradingView](https://in.tradingview.com/?aff_id=167054) Screener  
TradingView’s charting prowess extends to its screener, which offers over 100 technical indicators and the ability to run Pine Script‑based custom filters. The community‑shared scripts mean you can tap into strategies built by other traders. Real‑time data is available for most major exchanges, and alerts sync seamlessly with your chart alerts.

### Tool C: StockFetcher  
StockFetcher shines when you need complex, multi‑step filters. Its syntax lets you create conditions like “price crossed above 50‑day MA while RSI < 30 and volume > 2× average.” Results update in near‑real time, and you can export watchlists directly to brokerage platforms for immediate execution.

### Tool D: Yahoo Finance Advanced
